touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Bourne qualifies as a local detour through Escape 2 Play and Baldocks Mill. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Bourne: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Bourne offers Escape 2 Play, Baldocks Mill, Delaine Bus Museum within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Escape 2 Play
